question: Over the 24 months of 2024 and 2025, which product category has the steepest upward trend in monthly units sold in completed orders? Give the category and the slope of a least-squares line, in units per month.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH monthly_category_units AS (SELECT p.category, SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS ym, SUM(oi.quantity) AS monthly_units, ((CAST(SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - 2024) * 12 + (CAST(SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - 1)) AS x FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.category, ym), regression_calc AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(x) AS sum_x, SUM(monthly_units) AS sum_y, SUM(x * monthly_units) AS sum_xy, SUM(x * x) AS sum_xx, SUM(monthly_units * monthly_units) AS sum_yy FROM monthly_category_units GROUP BY category) SELECT category, (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) * 1.0 / (n * sum_xx - sum_x * sum_x) AS slope FROM regression_calc ORDER BY slope DESC LIMIT 1
